name: oxly
displayName: Oxly — Chrome DevTools for AI Agents
description: Trace, cost, and security observability for AI agents. Phase 6: 6 project-scoped read-only MCP tools + 4-skill pack (overview, trace-debug, security-triage, cost-report) + status UI + submission-ready manifests. Superset of Phase 5 with paged get_trace spans (span_limit/span_offset), strict blank-ID and negative-date validation, and cacheable discovery docs.

mcp.note: Phase 6 serves 6 read-only tools: query_traces, get_trace, get_span, query_security_alerts, cost_summary, whoami. Inspector must get init ok. query_traces/query_security_alerts return total + limit/offset echo (count kept on alerts); status/severity/interval validated case-insensitively; get_trace pages spans via span_limit (default 200, max 200) + span_offset with span_count as the true total and spans_truncated flag; blank trace_id/span_id rejected; cost_summary validates start_date <= end_date and rejects negative/non-integer timestamps; DEMO_MODE allows keyless calls with explicit project_id.

ui.note: Production UI assets MUST be hosted at the stable HTTPS origin allow-listed by the API Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors/script-src). Local dev serves packages/plugin/ui/ at /plugin/ui/.

auth.note: Every MCP tool takes the project's SDK API key (ak_...) as api_key and scopes to that project (explicit project_id must match). DEMO_MODE=true allows keyless calls with explicit project_id for local exploration.

legal.note: Placeholder links until the hosted docs site ships; submission reviewers follow these URLs.

rateLimits.note: MCP shares the API 100 req/min per-IP limiter (429 with retry_after); tools clamp limit/offset server-side (50 traces, 100 alerts, 200 spans/page). Back off on 429.

caching.note: Discovery docs (/plugin/plugin.json, /plugin/mcp.json, /plugin/openapi.json + both .well-known aliases) are served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 and X-Oxly-Plugin-Phase: 6.

submission.dataUse: Read-only observability: tools never create, delete, or ingest data; PII is scrubbed before storage; no cross-project oracle (bad key, mismatched project_id, and out-of-scope ids are indistinguishable).
submission.checklist: manifest phase 6 + legal/openapi/rateLimits/caching notes; legacy /.well-known/ai-plugin.json alias; /plugin/openapi.json tool + pagination + error + rate-limit schemas; status UI with live MCP initialize check, dashboard deep links, and Phase 6 ops section; 4-skill pack bumped to phase 6.
